# ADR: Cross-device data sync strategy

## Status
OPEN — decision needed before any sync implementation begins

## Context
App stores all data in localStorage (single device). Users want data available across desktop browser, iOS PWA, and other browsers without the developer providing backend infrastructure.

## Options

### A — GitHub Gist
- User provides a GitHub PAT (gist scope), stored in localStorage
- Pull on open, push on save. Private Gist as JSON blob
- Pro: zero infra, no new accounts if user has GitHub
- Con: last-write-wins clobbers offline edits; PAT in localStorage; no real-time

### B — Firebase Realtime Database (free tier)
- User creates Firebase project, pastes 4 config values into app settings
- Real-time listener — changes appear on all devices instantly
- Pro: true live sync, offline-first SDK, free tier sufficient for personal use
- Con: Google dependency; Firebase project setup required; pairs cleanly with multi-profile

### C — File System Access API + Dropbox/Google Drive desktop client
- User picks a JSON file once (showSaveFilePicker); handle persists in IndexedDB
- File lives in Dropbox/Drive folder; desktop sync client handles cross-machine sync
- Desktop Chrome/Edge/Android Chrome: fully automatic read/write
- iOS Safari/PWA: FSAA not supported — manual export/import only (share sheet → Files app)
- Pro: no accounts, no API keys, leverages existing sync infrastructure
- Con: iOS is always manual; not real-time; desktop-first story

### D — Manual export/import only
- Export button downloads JSON; import reads it back
- User manages file placement in Dropbox/Drive/iCloud manually
- Pro: zero complexity, works everywhere including iOS
- Con: fully manual, no automation

## Constraints
- No developer-hosted backend
- Must work on iOS PWA (even if degraded)
- Should survive multi-profile feature (whichever option chosen, needs to sync profile-namespaced data)

## Dependencies
- Should be decided AFTER multi-profile (T-001–T-005) — sync data model is simpler once profile structure is settled

## Decision
